title: Puppet Master common forge integration contracts
description: Provider-neutral repository bindings, authority, capabilities, mirrors, immutable review revisions and threads, pipelines, app grants, signed webhooks, API compatibility, provider adapter profiles, and discriminated Forge command request/result/error/availability/receipt contracts. Static shape closure does not establish central registration, Event Authority, native handlers, production wiring, protected-browser execution, or runtime proof.

automation.description: Compatibility projection for repository-local automation capability only. It never selects an automation service, provider, instance, account, permission, or generation; pm.forge.automation_binding.v1 is authoritative for hosted automation.
